domains: CIGRE MV electrical distribution with DER

E1.name: Exact minimax identity
E1.pass_rule: all tested observable subsets have relative identity error < 1e-8

E2.name: Bounded scalar ambiguity
E2.pass_rule: SOCP minimax and half-witness gap differ by < 2e-5

E3.name: No-compensation
E3.pass_rule: no half-gap lower-bound violation under bad sensing

E4.name: Equal count unequal information
E4.restriction: sensor cardinality is held exactly fixed within each domain

E5.name: Gaussian propagation
E5.pass_rule: at least 90% of tested configurations are within 10% of the theoretical MSE

E6.name: Task-projected learning
E6.feature_map: fixed bounded tanh random feature map
E6.pass_rule: no excess-risk certificate violation; no Rademacher violation beyond 3% Monte-Carlo allowance

E7.name: Sensor-resource frontier
E7.pass_rule: SVD-whitened primal and dual are feasible; certified dual lower bound <= exact binary optimum <= feasible rounded cost; task residual <= 1e-10

E8.name: Nonlinear locality stress
E8.pass_rule: none; adverse results are retained and reported

anti_cherry_picking: Do not remove a declared domain because its result is unfavorable.
Do not change pass thresholds after production results.
Do not retune the operating envelope merely to improve a plot.
A failed declared domain remains visible in the run logs and a full run returns a nonzero status.
